CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 09 / 12

Production possibilities frontier (PPF)

Economy-wide PPF整體 PPF

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Construct or interpret an economy-wide PPF from workers with different productivities, allocating production in order of comparative advantage; recognize inefficient allocations within the frontier.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先安排機會成本最低的人做相應商品。不同工人依次轉換活動，整體邊界可有折點；人人忙碌仍可能因分工不當而無效率。

Allocate each good first to workers with the lowest opportunity cost. As different workers switch activity, the aggregate PPF can have kinks. Producing inside that boundary can reflect inefficient assignment, even if everyone is busy.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：A makes 10 X or 20 Y; B makes 6 X or 6 Y. Starting from all Y, move B to X first: it sacrifices 1 Y per X, versus A's 2. 先轉 B 的代價較低。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

From all-Y production, who should switch to X first in the example? 誰應先轉做 X？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
